Its SFD is unchanged from upstream commit 145864fa8c96bf51994f5f9bedfef16011ee7cd9 (2015-07-19), which introduced this font version. The release TTF is not byte-identical to the Chromium TTF; glyph generation differs, and byte reproducibility is not claimed.
